caption.text:
Wangsa Kartika, salah seorang pegawai di toko Yoga Shanty, saat ditemui detikBali, Selasa (28/7/2026) menyebut tidak tahu soal identitas perempuan asing itu. Dia hanya mengingat ciri-cirinya, yakni berambut gelap, memakai baju hijau, celana pendek, dan membawa tas besar putih.

“Tadi sudah ada polisi yang datang dan meminta keterangan. Tetapi kami belum melayangkan laporan resmi. Hanya kami viralkan supaya tidak terjadi di tempat lain,” ucap Wangsa.

Menurut Wangsa, ini bukan kali pertama pencurian pakaian terjadi di toko Yoga Shanty. Toko tempat Wangsa bekerja itu sudah mengalami pencurian sebanyak empat kali.

Baca berita selengkapnya hanya di detik.com! 

Creator: Putri

#detikcom #pencurianbaju #bulenyuri #bali
caption.text_translation:
Wangsa Kartika, one of the employees of Yoga Shanty shop, when found in SekiBali, Tuesday (28/7/2026) said she didn't know about the identity of the foreign woman. She only remembers her features, i.e. dark hair, wearing a green shirt, shorts, and carrying a big white bag.

"A while ago there was a police who came and asked for an explanation. But we have not released an official report. We only make it viral so it doesn't happen anywhere else," Wangsa said.

According to Wangsa, this is not the first time clothing theft has happened at a Yoga Shanty store. The shop where Wangsa works has been robbed four times.

Read full news only at detik.com !

 Creator: Putri
